Type: track arm loveseat
Use: sitting, lounging; living room, small apartment, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, piped edges, dark wood feet
Colors: dark charcoal, dark brown feet
Shape: wide square track arms, two plush back cushions, two seat cushions, piping, short block feet, compact but deep and solid
Feel: cozy, grounded, comfortable
Goes with: light grey or white walls, mid wood, colorful cushions; modern living rooms
